subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

His grandfather was quite __grumpy__ .
solution:
The correct answer is ** 'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word '**grumpy**' means bad-tempered and irritable; cranky.(चिड़चिड़ा)

 
 
• **Example**- He was in a **grumpy **mood today.
 
 
 
• "**Amiable**" means having or displaying a friendly and pleasant manner; friendly.(सुशील)
 
 
• **Example**- Balard had a kind and **amiable **personality, to which students responded warmly.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **grumpy **is **amiable**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Amiable**.
